v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
text.en: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

text.la: Maiórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
text.en: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text.la: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

text.la: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
text.en: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

text.la: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
text.en: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

text.la: Fratres: Iam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Iesu.
text.en: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Quia vidísti me * Thoma, credidísti: beáti qui non vidérunt, et credidérunt, allelúia.
text.en: Because thou hast seen me, * Thomas, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen and have believed, alleluia.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáti Apóstoli tui Thomæ solemnitátibus gloriári: ut eius semper et patrocíniis sublevémur; et fidem cóngrua devotióne sectémur.
text.en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech thee, to glory in the solemnity of thy blessed Apostle Thomas, that we may ever be aided by his patronage, and follow his faith with true devotion.

title.la: Feria II infra Hebdomadam IV Adventus
title.en: Feria II infra Hebdomadam IV Adventus

text.la: Nolíte timére; quinta enim die véniet ad vos Dóminus noster.
text.en: Fear not: yet five days and the Lord shall come unto you.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: et magna nobis virtúte succúrre; ut per auxílium grátiæ tuæ, quod nostra peccáta præpédiunt, indulgéntia tuæ propitiatiónis accéleret:
text.en: Stir up, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy power, and come; make haste to our aid with thy great might; that, by the help of thy grace, that which is hindered by our sins may be hastened by thy merciful forgiveness.
